palette: raw paper + hard black + cobalt + vermilion + signal yellow
typography: heavy grotesk hierarchy with label blocks, thin rules, external negation, and offset verdict stamps
composition: asymmetric wedges, opposed claim axes, hinged inversion planes, exemption gates, special-rule lanes, and ascending proof paths
surface: flat hard-edged planes, clipped diagonals, exposed rules, and no rounded cards or balance-scale motif
motion: directional cuts follow burden attribution; inversion planes settle onto defendants; exemption and presumption thresholds close or open proof paths; final paths rise in legal reasoning order
transition: hard diagonal cut under a persistent black proof axis
